summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired the company's own book-entry ordinary shares (1 vote each, AR$1 par) under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 — the local equivalent of a US issuer share buyback. On 11/04/2026 CPSA bought 120,000 shares on BYMA at an average AR$1,708.16, totaling AR$204,979,814, settling 11/05/2026; no NYSE purchases occurred. Daily volume stayed under 25% of the 90-day average. Watch ongoing buyback pace and treasury-share overhang.
